scope: Read-only: the committed per-cell read-out applied to the same thirty statistics at three samplings (target, predicted, detected board box), no training, no refit on this arm's inputs and no weight change.

readout.refit_note: the committed artifact ships out-of-fold logits, not coefficients, so the read-out is reconstructed by running its own committed estimator on the committed features, labels and folds and is accepted only when it reproduces those logits to 1e-6; the same fitted folds then transform the detected-box and predicted features, so no parameter is fitted on this arm's rows

detection.recipe: single-objective search over wall and grid candidates

no_regression.rule: every board M50 placed within the declared gate must stay within it (or within its own previous value plus the declared slack) after the repair

branch.reading: repair-under-specified: the median board is placed, but a minority of captures carry more than one defensible box, so the search is under-determined there and the population mean stays above the gate
